questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word(s) in the given sentence. Manik said that it is mandatory that each student pay his/her tuition fees every month.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word(s) in the given sentence.

Manik said that it is mandatory that each student pay his/her tuition fees every month.
questions.solution: 'pays' will be used instead of 'pay' because "each student" is a singular subject, and according to the rule of subject-verb agreement, a singular subject takes a singular verb. The sentence is in the present tense as "it is mandatory" indicates the current obligation. Therefore, the use of the verb "pays" is correct. For example— It is required that each employee follows the rules properly.

the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The farmer stood by the roadside stand to sell his _________.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The farmer stood by the roadside stand to sell his _________.
questions.solution: 'Produce' will be used because it refers to fruits, vegetables, and other agricultural goods that farmers sell. The sentence mentions that the farmer is standing at the roadside stand to sell his goods, making "produce" appropriate here. 'Consequence' means a result, 'Volume' refers to the amount or quantity of something, 'Productivity' refers to efficiency in production, none of which fit in this context.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . The threat of El Nino (A) / has now ebbed, (B) / which had helped the (C) / monsoon regain momentum. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The threat of El Nino (A) / has now ebbed, (B) / which had helped the (C) / monsoon regain momentum. (D)

options.html: The threat of El Nino (A)
which had helped the (C)

questions.solution:
• 'helping' or 'and it helped' will be used instead of 'which had helped' due to a relative clause error. The past perfect ("had helped") is unnecessary here since the main verb ("has ebbed") is in present perfect, and both actions are concurrent. Like—
The rains stopped, helping the farmers resume work.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . The sowing of summer crops (A) / such as rice, soybeans and corn (B) / have been (C) / lagging as a result. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The sowing of summer crops (A) / such as rice, soybeans and corn (B) / have been (C) / lagging as a result. (D)

options.html: The sowing of summer crops (A)

options.text: such as rice, soybeans and corn (B)
options.html: such as rice, soybeans and corn (B)
lagging as a result. (D)

questions.solution:
• 'has been' will be used instead of 'have been' because there is a subject-verb agreement error. The main subject "The sowing" (singular) requires the singular verb "has been", not the plural "have been"; Like—
The planting of trees has been delayed due to the rains.

A. However, physical fitness and a stubborn fearlessness never let a climber fail.

B. The equipment can be made so light that no extra energy is spent in carrying it.

C. To a large extent, the physical difficulties can be reduced by paying attention to the equipment.

questions.solution: It is certain that weather plays an important part in the success or failure of mountain climbers To a large extent, the physical difficulties can be reduced by paying attention to the equipment The equipment can be made so light that no extra energy is spent in carrying it However, physical fitness and a stubborn fearlessness never let a climber fail
